determinism.note: Instances are regenerated in worker subprocesses from (n, edge_prob, seed) so a worker and its driver build bit-identical graphs without serialising them.

timing_discipline.note: Wall-clock harnesses were never run concurrently; two at once would contaminate each other. While a subagent was working, only correctness work was run alongside it.
timing_discipline.censored_runs: recorded as wall_until_timeout_s, never as a measurement; an earlier version of the harness reused the seconds key and let a timeout read as a datum (see LOG.md)

files.profile_local_up.jsonl: where local_up spends its time, per instance
files.fast_covers_differential.json: enumeration-free covers vs the frozen implementation
files.fast_vs_frozen.jsonl: head-to-head timings, one subprocess per (instance, method)
files.criterion_agreement.json: criterion vs the enumeration oracle, exhaustive + n=5 stress
files.criterion_stress_walks.json: targeted stress of the walk-relaxation, 1,131,460 cases
files.criterion_timings.json: per-call timings before and after the polynomial rewrite
files.oracle_envelope_pathenum.jsonl: EVIDENCE OF THE DEFECT: the path-enumerating criterion
files.stage2_rerun.json: E1 failure predicate vs both oracles, stratified by amenability
files.hybrid_differential.json: hybrid vs brute force at n=4 under both oracles
files.hybrid_envelope.jsonl: the operating envelope, per instance, tagged with method and oracle

assumption_status.lemma_O: proved; carries no assumption, changes cost not answers
assumption_status.mpdag_criterion: differentially verified against the enumeration oracle; the walk-relaxation in the state search is argued and stress-tested, not proved
assumption_status.radius_from_either_search_leg: exact iff Conjecture 2, hence Anti-Exchange Case B, which is verified not proved; the error is one-sided and can only overstate robustness
